header.title: Theme Toggle
header.subtitle: A ghost icon-only button that switches between light and dark mode globally. Uses next-themes for state persistence and a mounted guard to prevent SSR hydration mismatch.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: A Tooltip wraps a ghost icon-only Button. The icon switches between Sun (dark mode) and Moon (light mode) based on the resolved theme after mount.

live.title: Live demo
live.description: The toggle below is the real component — clicking it changes the theme for the entire application. It is not isolated to this demo.
live.note: Clicking this toggle changes the theme of the entire application. It is the real component, not a sandboxed demo.

hydration.title: Hydration guard
hydration.description: Before the component mounts on the client, the resolved theme from localStorage is unavailable. A mounted state flag prevents a Sun/Moon mismatch between the SSR output and the first client render.

composition.title: Composition
composition.description: The full component source — copy-paste into any layout that needs a theme toggle.

props.title: Props
props.description: ThemeToggle takes no props. Theme state is managed globally by next-themes.

anatomy.tooltip: Tooltip wrapper — provides the accessible label on hover
anatomy.button: Button variant ghost with iconOnly — renders as a square icon button with no visible border
anatomy.icon: Sun icon in dark mode, Moon icon in light mode — switches after mount based on resolvedTheme
